shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at (3, 2) in the left image with the marker at −1 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The plotted branch excludes the right endpoint (3, 2). Right image: The marked interval excludes its left endpoint −1.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image excludes the indicated boundary point. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
